equity.equity_measurement: Race/ethnicity is a Table descriptor only; NH ethnicity assumed when unknown, AI/AN and multiracial collapsed into 'All other races', cells <10 suppressed. LTCF residence is described but not framed as social position.

notes: The age-group rate ratio (nine times 18–64) is a comparison; the 45.9% to 62.9% share change is a two-period comparison, both supported by chi-square tests and Taylor-linearized variances. Age-stratified rate series are comparisons by age, not stratified analysis, and no adjusted or regression analysis is reported. Vaccination coverage among hospitalized adults is descriptive, not the primary question, so vaccine_outcome_type is null.
